findings.title: The failed scan set is cleared only when the connection leaves ready, so an error raised while offline sticks until the next outage
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE > Media index scan (failed set; Live upkeep clearing rule)
findings.problem: A page error during a connection outage (auth still ready) adds the chat to failed after the clear has already run, so the reconnect does not give it the promised new try; it waits for the next outage or a restart.
findings.fix: current is cleared whenever updateConnectionState leaves ready; failed is cleared whenever it enters ready.

findings.title: An upload TDLib is still sending after a restart has no live state, so it holds no slot and shows no progress
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE > Transfer engine > Pump (free = limit minus jobs with live state); Upload step 6 (sendingStatePending -> keep waiting)
findings.problem: With the review-4 free rule, a recovered pending upload does not count against maxUploads, so a second upload starts beside it; its updateFile events are unrouted, so its Queue bar is frozen until it settles. No duplicate posts; throughput and cosmetics only.
findings.fix: Either: a pending id in sendingStatePending gives its job live state (file id from extractMedia(m).file.id into inFlight), or add a ponytail: note with the upgrade path in Upload step 6 and PROGRESS.

findings.title: The review-4 response header will point at the wrong review file
findings.where: ARCHITECTURE > Design review 4: responses; PROGRESS > Phases > 1. Setup
findings.problem: docs/.design-review.md now holds review 5; the review-4 header does not say so, unlike earlier response sections.
findings.fix: Header: 'Review 4 (CHANGES_REQUESTED, 0 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM, 2 NIT; docs/.design-review.md now holds review 5, APPROVED)'; tick 'Design review 5 approved' in PROGRESS Phase 1.
